## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change is needed.

Related issue (if any):

## Validation

- [ ] Required GitHub `build` check passes on the current PR revision
- [ ] Complete diff reviewed and review conversations resolved
- [ ] Relevant in-game checks recorded (or explain why not applicable)
- [ ] Compatibility limitations documented
- [ ] Copied code/dependencies have provenance and license notices
- [ ] AI assistance disclosed where applicable

For renderer changes, record mod/loader/shader versions and the in-game result.
For documentation-only changes, explain why gameplay testing is unnecessary.

## Compatibility and release impact

State known limitations and whether this needs a new release. Merging does not
publish a jar. Release preparation must include the version, changelog, test
record and applicable notices; use a new version rather than replacing old assets.
